objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: The document abbreviation can be adapted to different requirements and is not language-independent.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: The assignment of the consecutive number can be adapted to different requirements.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for user group assignment for reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute in which the creator of a document is automatically confirmed by default and which can be changed.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute for reviewers assigned to a document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute for releasers assigned to a document.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute mentioned with releaser for translation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date used with the period of extended validity to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type for which a check of extended validity is necessary.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type for archiving.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type used to document detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating new documents and configurable in DHC VISION.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for each document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New documents and additional objects are created by attachment of a new information object.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific document data maintained automatically or by the user.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents can be linked and for which process-specific filing is provided.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master data with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type that can supplement a document with additional information and is released and published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

objs.name: form
objs.description: Additional form with which work instructions can be supplemented.

objs.name: checklist
objs.description: Additional checklist with which work instructions can be supplemented.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual who can be assigned roles, authorizations, tasks and notifications.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual to whom personal authorizations and distribution can be assigned.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used to assign read and change rights for documents.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role whose users can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Role whose assigned users receive read and write permissions and whose registered author signs creation of the document.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Role with personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Role responsible for the document and its content and for deciding distribution to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language and cannot independently create new objects.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person who creates a document or request and may be workflow participant.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group that still has read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change right assigned to groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing for release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation and acknowledgements.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task whose status and existence are communicated to users by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: version
objs.description: Version of a document retained, adapted, released, revised, archived, invalidated or reactivated.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for existing documents that belongs to a document and can lead to a new document version.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate documents and start the workflow for override.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution for documents.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from persons and users of assigned user groups upon release.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users for workflow tasks, release, change proposals, validity extension, override and acknowledgement.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled from distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report with selection parameters and selection criteria.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Language-dependent version of released content that must be checked and released.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: A corresponding document type is selected when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A document template can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: A pure object cover can be created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Document properties are described and maintained with attributes and metadata.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using an implemented editing client.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Once the document has been saved, conversion to PDF is performed automatically.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The saved document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: The current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changes to released documents result in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in document properties.

evts.name: allocate_workflow_participant
evts.description: Workflow participants are allocated in the document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be added to each document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be added to each document by attachment of a new information object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of attachments triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachments can be marked for archiving and archived with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: After document creation, maintenance and document control definition, the approval process can be initiated.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: In the Creator workflow step, the registered author signs creation of the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document in the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete the release step and release the document.

evts.name: reject_review
evts.description: A rejection during review cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately.

evts.name: reject_release
evts.description: A rejection during release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants immediately.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: The system informs involved users by e-mail notification.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Signatures are documented in the system for each released version.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: A valid and released document can be revised.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new version is created automatically or by the author in specified cases.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employees with author rights can create change proposals for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal_for_implementation
evts.description: A change proposal can be scheduled for implementation.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: check_extended_validity
evts.description: Extended validity of a document is checked by assigned participants depending on the process.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared and the document remains valid in its current version.

evts.name: update_valid_until
evts.description: The valid until date is updated by the default value of 3 years.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The request for validity extension is deleted after additional validity or release of a new revised version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: The process for validity extension is automatically terminated when a new revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Users with write access can create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: After attachment of the request for AKS, the workflow for processing the request starts automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: A document is declared out of force during override.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: All rights except for the archive group are revoked for archived documents.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Existing edited versions are deleted after declaration of out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: After the archive period expires, documents are physically deleted.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created and the corresponding document is selected.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: The workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Reactivation is confirmed by the creator of the request.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups and persons are assigned to the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned user groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Each recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Distribution groups in the distribution list fill user and role-specific dashboards.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Role-specific evaluation reports and searches evaluate documents according to selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: A new document is created in a client for local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: A reference to the original document is created for a local document.
